summary: Master ISO 27001 Information Security. Learn to implement a certified ISMS, manage risks, and apply Annex A controls. Enroll now for practitioner-led training.
lede: ISO 27001 information security training covers how security and compliance professionals can develop and maintain an information security management system (ISMS). It addresses practical tasks such as defining the ISMS scope, assessing information risks and selecting relevant controls, alongside security governance, incident response and internal audits. These capabilities help professionals organize security activities and evaluate how the system is performing.
audienceIntro: This course is essential for professionals responsible for the integrity of organizational data and the maintenance of international security standards.
modules: Annex A Organizational and People Controls
Annex A Physical and Technological Controls
prerequisites: Participants should have an intermediate understanding of IT infrastructure and basic information security principles. Familiarity with the general concepts of risk management and previous experience working within an IT or compliance function is highly recommended. No prior experience with ISO standards is required, though a review of your organization's current security policies will provide helpful context for the practical exercises.
